en.html:
The Ootori were an old name among the great warrior houses. Very old.
Their beginnings went back beyond the Heian period. For much of that time they had overseen the imperial court's warriors, or held a position close to it. Of the houses of Shakuten lineage, theirs alone had carried its bloodline into the present.

When the Six Guards Offices—the Rikuefu—formed as a warrior body and foremost imperial guard, the Ootori supplied many of its commanders, the Six Guards Lord Generals. For a while they even kept succession to that office entirely within the family. In pedigree, the Ashikaga ruling today could not match them.

Rise and fall was the rule of the world. The Ootori had apparently applied for exemption and received a thousand years. Position intact. Actual power intact also. How?
Through an almost miraculous unity, it seemed. The internal struggles that ruined other great houses were stopped here before they could begin.
No splitting into two halves to fight each other. On that basis, the family kept adding to its history.
A fine tradition. Recently, however, even that had broken.

ja.html:
大鳥氏は武家の名門としてつとに知られる。
　発祥は平安期以前へ遡り、長く宮中の武者を統括、
ないしそれに準ずる立場にあった。<ruby>所謂<rt>いわゆる</rt></ruby>釈天御由緒家
のうち、現代まで血脈を伝えた唯一の家である。

　武者集団にして近衛軍筆頭としての六衛府が形成さ
れて後はその総領たる六衛大将領を多く輩出し、のみ
ならず一時期は完全に一族内で世襲さえしていた。
　家格の点では現在の覇者足利氏も及ばない。

　栄枯盛衰が<ruby>理<rt>ことわり</rt></ruby>であるこの世にあって、なぜ大鳥氏は
千年にも渡って地位と実力を保持し得たのか。
　理由は権門にありがちな内部抗争を奇跡的な結束に
よって未然に防ぎ続けてきたところに求められよう。

　家を二つに割って争うような致命的決裂を味わわず、
大鳥家は歴史を重ねてきたのだった。
　しかし、その良き伝統は近年になって遂に断たれて
いる。

en.html:
Koryu 30. What would later be called the eve of the Great War.
Yamato looked peaceful on the surface. Underneath, tensions with Europe over continental interests rose daily. People felt war coming. Excitement, and a chill beneath it.

The Ootori head was a believer in the extreme right. No concessions to Europe. Expand the military, prepare for war. Day and night he worked for it—and his influence was considerable. The country began steering where he wanted.
His younger brother, Kanae's father, disagreed. He watched the situation with growing concern, then decided.
Against his own elder brother, he launched a coup. Power changed hands.

ja.html:
興隆三〇年。後に大戦前夜と呼ばれる時代のこと。
　大和は表面上の平穏こそ保っていたが、水面下では
大陸の利権を巡って欧州諸国との緊張を日毎に高め、
人々は戦争の気配を察して高揚と肌寒さを覚えていた。

　時の大鳥当主は極右思想の信奉者であり、欧州側へ
の譲歩を拒み開戦に備えて軍拡を推し進めるべく日夜
活動していた。
　その影響力は大きく、国は彼の望む方角へ舵を切る。

　が、彼と意見を異にしていた弟――香奈枝の父――
はそんな情勢を憂えた末、決断。
　兄に対して<ruby>下剋上<rt>クーデター</rt></ruby>を起こし、権力を奪取する。

en.html:
The head of the house was confined. Soon afterward, he died. Assassination, people whispered. Whether the whispers were true was another question.
His young legitimate son was rescued during the coup by his father's own retainers, and escaped somewhere unknown.

The younger brother, now head of the house, tried to turn continental policy toward conciliation. Taking the seat was one thing. Making anything move from the seat was quite another. Fierce opposition inside and outside had him struggling from the start. Inside the Ootori family, especially...
Perhaps they simply could not accept the man who had broken their tradition of unity. Many of them had worried about the old head's policy. That did not prevent them from opposing the new one. All together now, they practiced resistance and sabotage. Unity had found a fresh purpose.

ja.html:
当主は幽閉され、間もなく世を去った。暗殺の噂が
囁かれたのは無論である――真偽は置いて。
　彼には幼い嫡男があったが、これはクーデターの際
に直臣の手で救出され、何処かへ逃げおおせている。

　兄を逐って当主の座に着いた弟は大陸経略を融和の
路線に切り替えるべく活動し始めるも、内外の厳しい
反発に<ruby>端<rt>はな</rt></ruby>から苦闘を強いられることになった。
　特に内側、大鳥一門の抵抗が激しく……

　結果として一族団結の伝統を踏みにじった弟を心情
的にどうにも受け入れ難かったのか。前当主の方針に
危惧を抱いていた者は少なくなかったにも拘わらず、
彼らはこぞって<ruby>反抗<rt>レジスト</rt></ruby>と<ruby>怠慢<rt>サボタージュ</rt></ruby>の徒と化した。

en.html:
The new head had enemies outside to deal with, and his own people inside to pacify. With both jobs together, his politics barely moved. Delay, yes. Results, no.

Still, he did not give up. Fate, of course, had already crept up behind him and was pointing and laughing.

Now, there was a young man in the Ootori family who had been adopted from another house. Young, and an outsider by origin. Yet ability had put him in charge of a branch house. Not a small achievement.



His name was Shishiku. He was also a fervent admirer of the previous head.

ja.html:
内部の反発を宥めつつ外部の敵に対処せねばならな
かった新当主の政治活動は遅滞し、成果を挙げない。
　それでも彼は断念しなかったが、勿論運命はとうに
彼の背後まで忍び寄り、指差して笑っていたのである。

　当時の大鳥家には、元々他家から入った養子であり
しかも若年でありながら、才覚によって分家の一つを
任されるまでになった人物がいた。



　名を<ruby>獅子吼<rt>ししく</rt></ruby>。前当主に心酔していた男でもある。

en.html:
Shishiku would not accept the usurpation. Another coup would put the house right. That was his decision.
Except that he was an outsider, now leading a branch family. If he took the headship himself, where was the correction? One wrong plus one wrong. The total did not become right.

He insisted on proper order. For his coup's figurehead, he wanted the rightful successor: the previous head's legitimate son. He searched for the boy. Found nothing. Time, meanwhile, had no difficulty passing.
Continental tensions rose further. The new head still showed no spirit for leading an army; he kept looking for conciliation. To Shishiku, pure foolishness.
At last, he decided.

ja.html:
彼は簒奪を断固として許容せず、再びのクーデター
によって家を正さんと決意していた。
　が、他所者上がりの分家当主である彼が当主の座を
奪っては、誤りに誤りを重ねる結果にしかならない。

　物事の筋道に固執する獅子吼はクーデターの旗頭と
して、正しく当主の座を継ぐべき者――即ち前当主の
嫡子を戴こうと望み、その行方を探し求めた。
　しかし<ruby>杳<rt>よう</rt></ruby>として知れぬまま、時ばかりが移ろい……

　その間にも大陸情勢は緊張を増し、にも拘わらず新
当主は軍を率いて立つ気概を示すこともなく、獅子吼
からすれば愚考でしかない融和の模索に傾倒している。
　ここに至って彼は遂に決意する。

en.html:
Leading soldiers under his direct command, he made a sudden attack on the head of the house and killed him. In his place, he installed the man's second daughter, Hanae.



Her father had been killed, and she herself made a puppet: Hanae could hardly have wanted this. For Shishiku too, presumably, this was a bitter choice.

In his reckoning, she was temporary only. The true head was her cousin. On that point, no change in his position.

Once Shishiku had brought the clan under his control and become its effective ruler, he meant to use that power to resume the search at once. Find the boy, find the rightful head. But—

直属の兵を率いて当主を急襲、殺害し、後釜として
その次女花枝を据えた。



　父を殺された上に<ruby>傀儡<rt>かいらい</rt></ruby>とされた花枝が本意であった
筈もないが、獅子吼にしても苦渋の選択だったろう。

en.html:
Time for that search? None. The Great War broke out.

...He finally found the person he wanted six full years after the war ended. This year: Koryu 41.
Kanae had found him a little earlier, through the intelligence net she cast from abroad. She had been studying in Europe when Shishiku staged his coup. A home to return to—suddenly she had none.

She moved from country to country in Europe, but never stopped watching Yamato. Information about the Ootori family, especially, she kept gathering.
It paid off. She located her cousin, then learned that Shishiku would soon find him also.
Using her military status in the Habsburg Dual Empire, she obtained a posting with the League's occupation forces in Yamato. Back she came, a GHQ officer.
That was early autumn of this year.

ja.html:
実際はそんな暇も無く、〝大戦〟が勃発する。
　
　……彼がようやく望む人物の所在を突き止めたのは
大戦終結から実に六年後、<ruby>興隆四一年<rt>ことし</rt></ruby>のことである。

　それにやや先んじて、国外から諜報の網を投げ掛け
ていた香奈枝もその人物を見つけ出していた。
　彼女は獅子吼のクーデターのおり丁度欧州に留学中
であったため、帰る家を失くした格好だったのだが、

　欧州諸国を転々としつつも大和の状況に気を配り、
特に大鳥家に関わる情報の収集は怠らなかった。
　その甲斐あって従兄弟の行方を掴み、また獅子吼も
程なく彼を発見するであろうことを知ると、

　香奈枝は取得していた<ruby>二重帝国<rt>ハプスブルク</rt></ruby>の軍籍を用いて国連
大和進駐軍に配属。ＧＨＱ将校として帰国する。
　
　それが――この年の初秋。
